fullPassage: The reason pessimists often sound smart is that they can avoid being 'wrong' by moving the goalposts. When a doomer predicts that the world will end in five years, and it doesn't, they just shift the date. The American biologist Paul R. Ehrlich — author of the 1968 book The Population Bomb — has been doing this for decades. In 1970 he said that 'sometime in the next 15 years, the end will come. And by "the end" I mean an utter breakdown of the capacity of the planet to support humanity.' Of course, that was terribly wrong. He had another go: he said that 'England will not exist in the year 2000.' Wrong again. Ehrlich will keep pushing this deadline back. A pessimistic stance is a safe one.

det.tip: prediction(n. 예측) → predict(v. 예측하다) → predicts(3인칭 단수)

questions.passage: A __________ (pessimism) stance is a safe one. Pessimists can avoid being 'wrong' by moving the goalposts.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 관사 A와 명사 stance 사이에 형용사가 필요. pessimism(명사) → pessimistic(형용사)으로 어형 변환. 'A pessimistic stance' = 비관적인 입장
det.tip: pessimism(n. 비관주의) → pessimistic(adj. 비관적인) → pessimist(n. 비관론자)

questions.passage: The reason pessimists often sound smart is that they can avoid being 'wrong' by __________. When a doomer predicts that the world will end in five years, and it doesn't, they just shift the date. The American biologist Paul R. Ehrlich — author of the 1968 book The Population Bomb — has been doing this for decades. In 1970 he said that 'sometime in the next 15 years, the end will come. And by "the end" I mean an utter breakdown of the capacity of the planet to support humanity.' Of course, that was terribly wrong. He had another go: he said that 'England will not exist in the year 2000.' Wrong again. Ehrlich will keep pushing this deadline back. A pessimistic stance is a safe one.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① changing the subject(주제를 바꾸다): 화제 전환이지 기준 변경 아님
❌ ② raising the stakes(판돈을 올리다): 위험도 증가이지 기준 변경 아님
❌ ③ missing the point(요점을 놓치다): 이해 실패이지 기준 변경 아님
✅ ④ moving the goalposts(골대를 옮기다): 틀리지 않기 위해 기준/규칙을 바꾸는 것 — 원문 일치 ←정답
det.tip: move the goalposts = 규칙/기준을 자기 유리하게 바꾸다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Ehrlich는 이 마감일을 계속 미룰 것이다
det.analysis:
✅ ① pushing this deadline back(마감일을 미루다): 틀린 예측의 날짜를 계속 뒤로 미룸 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② accepting his mistakes openly(실수를 공개 인정): 비관론자가 실수를 인정하지 않는다는 것이 글의 요지
❌ ③ proving his theory right(이론을 증명): 예측이 틀렸으므로 증명 불가
❌ ④ abandoning his predictions entirely(예측을 완전히 포기): 글에서 계속 예측을 반복한다고 묘사
